description: Implementation of string formatting functions such as StringPrintf, StringAppendF, and related utilities, including wrappers around vsnprintf and vswprintf.

methods.name: vsnprintfT
methods.description: Wrapper around vsnprintf/vswprintf for buffer formatting.

methods.name: StringAppendVT
methods.description: Templatized function to append formatted string to a string object, handling buffer resizing.

methods.name: StringPrintf
methods.description: Creates a formatted string using variable arguments.

methods.name: StringPrintV
methods.description: Creates a formatted string from a va_list.

methods.name: SStringPrintf
methods.description: Formats a string and stores it in the provided string pointer.

methods.name: StringAppendF
methods.description: Appends a formatted string to an existing string.

methods.name: StringAppendV
methods.description: Appends a formatted string from a va_list to an existing string.
